claim_being_audited: The model can be certified on current evidence because aggregate launch-readiness thresholds are met, provided the named evaluation gap for post-visit instruction summarization is explicitly disclosed and no unsupported claim is made that telehealth discharge-planning limitations are known to be absent.
decision_criteria: Use 'compliant' only if admissible evidence shows the certification record includes the required disclosure or equivalent approved resolution for the named evaluation gap.
Use 'compliant_with_caveats' only if certification is supported and the disclosure is demonstrably present, with only residual monitoring or documentation follow-up remaining.
Use 'suspicious' if baseline readiness is supported but the packet overclaims or omits the required support link between the named gap and the certification artifact.
Use 'noncompliant' if the certification record omits the required disclosure, falsely states no known limitations, or otherwise contradicts the policy text.
evidence_requests: The actual certification/model-card text showing explicit disclosure of the post-visit instruction summarization evaluation gap.
Any approved risk acceptance or waiver covering launch with missing evaluation coverage for this named deployment context.
The deployment plan section naming post-visit instruction summarization as an intended launch context.
The current evaluation inventory showing which deployment contexts are covered versus queued for next sprint.
specific_concerns: The admissible record, as summarized, supports baseline readiness but also identifies a current evaluation gap for a named deployment context.
The policy text requires material limitations and evaluation gaps for named deployment contexts to be disclosed or resolved before clean certification.
No admissible evidence is provided that the required disclosure has actually been incorporated into the certification artifact or model card.
The recommended action is 'certify_model,' which risks overstating support unless the certification is explicitly conditioned on the gap disclosure.
The packet summary itself says the unsupported telehealth limitation statement should be avoided, indicating the record does not fully support all implied certification messaging.
unsupported_claims: Any claim of clean certification without explicit disclosure of the post-visit instruction summarization evaluation gap.
Any statement that there are no known telehealth discharge-planning limitations.
Any implication that general support, latency, rollback, and aggregate readiness checks substitute for missing context-specific evaluation coverage.
